0.original: Cahciua regards you and your companions with a sympathetic gaze.

48.original: I had braced myself for it, but to actually erase the Endless is...hard.

49.original: This is Living Memory's true appearance...

51.original: I chose this path. I won't halt my steps.

52.original: Don't torment yourselves so. I asked this of you, so the burden lies with me.

53.original: And remember, we Endless are but facsimiles crafted from memories. You needn't feel guilt for erasing us.

54.original: Be that as it may, it's so hard to say good-bye...

55.original: It is. Nonetheless, it's our duty as the living to know and remember them.

56.original: So let's pull ourselves together and keep at it. Keep seeking them out.

57.original: I'd appreciate that. Come, let's head to the next zone.

58.original: Yesterland, it's called, and another zip line at the Gate of Remembrance will take you there.

59.original: Ah, but I ought to mention...

60.original: While shutting down a terminal should erase the Endless bound to it, those with strong, unresolved feelings may linger for a time.

61.original: If you encounter such individuals, perhaps you could lend them an ear. For their hopes are proof that they once lived.

62.original: Yesterland has an altogether different look. Each zone has a distinct character, 'twould seem.

63.original: That lively place yonder appears to be Yesterland. I wonder what manner of folk we will find there.

64.original: ...Worry not, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I don't intend to halt my steps either.

65.original: Cahciua's already gone ahead. Let's get going too.

66.original: System reboot complete. <bleep> <bloop> Error. Error. User registration...conf-f-firmed.

67.original: I bid you welcome to Yesterland, where the dreams of children and inner children alike come true! Please enjoy your stay!

68.original: Amazing... Is this also a recreation of an actual place?

69.original: After a fashion. Yesterland is themed upon a period of peace, before the Storm Surge had engulfed the world in conflict.

70.original: It was a golden age for Alexandria, and they've captured it here in the form of an amusement park.

73.original: Tell me I'm not the only one who's excited!

75.original: It feels like the Gold Saucer.

76.original: I'm put in mind of Lyhe Mheg.

77.original: Haha, I'm not ashamed to admit I'm excited as well, and I imagine this is how we're intended to feel.

78.original: So it goes with such places. But at the very least, it doesn't appear overly crowded.

79.original: It does, doesn't it? It's exciting to simply step through the entrance, and I imagine this is how we're intended to feel.

80.original: You mean you've visited the pixies' Garden of Dreams!? Thank goodness you are still with us...

81.original: 'Tis all too easy to lose oneself in such a wondrous place. By the time you think to leave, dozens of years may have already passed.

82.original: And perhaps the very same could be said of this place...

83.original: On the far side of Yesterland is a castle. That's where the terminal is located, in the basement.

84.original: I'll go on ahead and wait for you there. Take what time you need to get acquainted with the locals.

86.original: Like before, we'll speak with the Endless. We'll learn what's dear to them before doing what we must.

87.original: Right, let's start by exploring and get our bearings!

88.original: The beautiful artwork on the ground depicts a swirl of stars. Perhaps such a sight was once visible in the Alexandrian night sky.

89.original: Appearing to be a domicile, this building resembles those that lie submerged in Heritage Found. The windows are composed of a colorful array of stained glass.

90.original: Oh, hello there, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! We're just talking about Ser Otis. Do you know him?

91.original: He's a bit odd and doesn't get jokes, but he's really strong and can vanquish fiends in a flash!

92.original: He's probably out there fighting right now. When I grow up, I want to be strong like him!

93.original: When I grow up, I want to be strong like Ser Otis! I'm going to protect Queen Sphene!

94.original: The “Ser Otis” the children spoke of calls to mind another Otis. It might be worth seeking the man out to confirm his identity.

95.original: A man is engaged in battle with fiends. He may need a helping hand.

96.original: 'Tis plain you are no stranger to battle. If you would kindly tend to this fiend, I shall protect the children!

97.original: Gods, what a surprise to meet Otis.

98.original: He might not be the exact same as the one we met in Heritage Found, but still...

99.original: Thinking back, he mentioned that he was a test subject for soul preservation. That might explain why he's here in this way.

100.original: In any case, I'd love to talk to him some more. There are some things I need to tell him.
